notes:
S1 disabled (engine=strategy2.py). 2026-08-24 session: NO PARAMETER CHANGES. Tonight was a CORRUPTION bug, and it was live.

THE BUG. test_ratchet.py was writing into the production state.json. It muted the logger and stubbed update_sl and tg.dm_owner, but _check_trail_s2 has a third writer one level down -- tracker.update_trail -> save_state() -> /root/trade/state.json. Every fixture trade in that suite is named 'ETH', which is the coin most likely to be open. It ran during the 08-23 02:00 session while the live ETH short was open and wrote its entry=100/R=1 ladder over that position's record: sl 2684.36 -> 103.0, locked_r 0.0 -> 3.0, plus six fabricated 'Trail +NR' activity lines.

WHAT IT COST. No money and no naked risk -- update_sl was stubbed, so no exchange order ever moved; the real stop sat at 2684.4 and the real TP at 2225.2 the whole time, confirmed against frontend_open_orders. The damage was that _check_trail_s2's monotonic guard is `new_sl < t['sl']` for a short, and nothing is below 103, so THE RATCHET WAS DEAD on that position from the 08-23 02:09 restart onward -- silently, no error, for 24h. The ratchet is where 100% of this strategy's measured edge lives (original stop meanR -0.979 over 10 trades vs ratcheted +1.705 over 6). Separately, tracker._live_text renders activity[-4:] into the position's CHANNEL message and the dashboard renders the locked_r badge, so the public record claimed '+3R locked' on a trade whose stop was still at -1.00R.

FIXED, three layers.
1. PREVENTION (test_ratchet.py): tracker.STATE_F is redirected to a temp file for the run. Redirecting the resource rather than stubbing the caller, because stubbing call sites is whack-a-mole -- this bug IS the third call site. New case 8 hashes the real state.json before and after and fails the suite if a byte moves, so the next writer added to that path cannot reintroduce it. 11/11 pass.
2. CORRECTION (live.py _reconcile_stop + executor.get_stop_price): on restore, the tracked stop is compared against the resting reduce-only stop on HL, which is the order that will actually fire and is therefore right by definition. Disagreement beyond 0.5% (the band absorbs trigger tick rounding: 2684.3609 goes on the book as 2684.4) adopts the exchange price, re-derives locked_r from it, repairs state.json on disk and DMs the owner. Never raises -- a restore that dies there would orphan the position, a strictly worse failure. VERIFIED LIVE: the 02:07 restart logged '[ETH] tracked SL $103 disagrees with the resting exchange stop $2684.4 -- adopting the exchange price' and the 02:08 restart was a clean no-op.
3. DETECTION (analyze.py OPEN BOOK): asserts locked_r <= MFE, and that the WORKING sl implies the recorded locked_r. The report read as a healthy armed ratchet for two nights because it printed sl_orig (clean) and locked_r (corrupt) and never printed sl (corrupt) -- a report that only shows the fields you expect to be right cannot catch the field that is wrong.

EXIT SWEEP RE-RUN, and it says the deployed value is right. sweep_trail_mode.py hardcoded a TRAIL_START_R grid of 0.50-1.50, which stopped containing the live constant when it went to 2.50 on 2026-08-05 -- sensitivity analysis for a system nobody runs. Grid now derives from s2.TRAIL_START_R with an assert. Real prices, 92 trades, 20 coins, cap 2: net by tsr under (close/touch_opt/touch_pess) = 1.00 +40.05/+43.52/+19.04, 1.50 +39.34/+61.28/+37.11, 2.00 +51.03/+58.01/+40.72, 2.50 +55.05/+62.67/+41.69, 3.00 +51.85/+65.18/+51.64. The live ETH trade peaking at 2.27R and missing the 2.50R arm by 0.23R is an argument for LOWERING it; the model says the opposite at every bound. Anecdote lost to the sweep, which is the point of running it.

TWO THINGS FOR KAMRAN, both owner-locked, reported not touched.
a) TRAIL_START_R 2.50 -> 3.00 improves the PESSIMISTIC bound by 24% (+41.69 -> +51.64) and the optimistic by 4%. Only `close` prefers 2.50, and close is the model the sweep exists to show is unrealistic.
b) A trail_gap_r of 0.25 -- forbidding the new stop from resting within 0.25R of price -- improves BOTH bounds at the deployed 2.50: touch_opt +62.67 -> +70.85, touch_pess +41.69 -> +48.11, WR unchanged at 45-46%. This is the direct fix for the ratchet placing its stop essentially at market (BTC 2026-08-03 armed at +0.75R and filled 22s later at +0.706R). It HURTS at tsr=2.00, so it is specific to the deployed setting. Not implemented: it would be a NEW exit parameter, i.e. changing deployed exit behaviour through the back door while TRAIL_START_R is locked.

NOT CHANGED and why: no S2 constant. No S1 numeric -- S1 is disabled, so tuning min_score/trail_pct/min_adx/session is theatre. Entry-band signals this month all point the same way (ADX 15-20 n=3 meanR +1.485 vs 20-25 n=13 -0.309; RSI 23-25 n=5 -0.667 vs RSI<20 n=3 +1.48; stretch 3+ n=10 +0.446 vs 2-3 n=5 -0.609) and all three would TIGHTEN the gate, but every one is owner-locked and n is single digits per cell. Live book is still n=16, t=+0.08 -- not distinguishable from a coin flip. Nothing here is tunable on it.
